topic: Heat Transfer and Static Charging Processes
key_concepts: Conduction transfers heat through direct contact, as with a metal spoon in hot liquid
Metals are conductors of heat while wood and plastic are not
Convection transfers heat in fluids, with hot water rising and cold water sinking
Radiation transfers heat without direct contact and can melt ice cream
Heat transfers from warmer objects to cooler objects
Rubbing objects transfers electrons and can leave one object negative and the other positi
Charging by friction occurs when two objects are rubbed together
Charging by conduction occurs when a charged body touches a neutral body
A charged object near a neutral conductor separates charges and causes attraction
Grounding through a finger lets electrons leave an object, leaving it positively charged
Static electricity can attract light objects such as hair, pepper, or salt
Electrons are negatively charged particles that can move between objects
